ITEM 1 | Triangular wedge of flatbread-like crust with pale cream-white interior and golden-brown browned spots and dark char marks on top, with reddish-orange sauce smears visible along the edge; soft, slightly moist-looking surface, sits at upper right of plate, roughly 10 cm long and 1.5 cm thick | 90

ITEM 2 | Four round cross-section slices of yellow corn cob, each about 4 cm across and 2.5 cm thick, bright yellow kernel ring surrounding a pale white center with small pith visible; slightly glossy, firm, sitting in a cluster on the lower right of the plate | 160

ITEM 3 | Thin reddish-orange sauce or tomato-based topping residue on the crust wedge, glossy and slightly wet, spread in small patches along the crust edge | 8
